name: magic-used-topaz-battle-bp
about: v0.116.0: (Opposing Attack Step) 'When you use a "Topaz" family Magic card, during this battle, this Spirit gains +2000 BP' = trigger MAGIC_USED with match {type Magic, family Topaz}, fired once the Magic has resolved; BP_TARGET battle:true keeps the bonus inside that battle. Stodol (26RBS01-061, LV2) watches; Life Link (26RBS01-121, a Topaz Magic) is cast in the opposing Attack Step.
